title: Contextualized Counterspeech: Strategies for Adaptation, Personalization, and Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on strategies for generating AI counterspeech to mitigate online toxicity. While it utilizes datasets containing hate speech directed at religious groups (e.g., MultiCONAN), its primary objective is evaluating the effectiveness and persuasiveness of different adaptation and personalization strategies rather than benchmarking religious frameworks, moral dilemmas, or formal ethical systems.
